title: The Mote in God's Eye
author: Larry Niven
summary: In the far future, humanity meets its first alien species, the Moties, when a probe arrives from a nearby star. A Navy expedition tries to understand them, and slowly realises they hide something dangerous.
readIf: you like classic first-contact science fiction built around clever alien biology.
skipIf: you want rounded characters and modern pacing rather than ideas-first 1970s storytelling.
